slides.headline: India just had its best August for car sales ever recorded.
A record month for passenger vehicles
slides.body: SIAM (Society of Indian Automobile Manufacturers) reported domestic passenger vehicle dispatches rose 36.5% year-on-year to 4,39,309 units in August 2026 - the highest-ever August figure on record.

slides.headline: SUVs now make up 57% of every car sold.
slides.body: Utility vehicles jumped 39.2% year-on-year to 2,50,084 units. Two-wheelers also posted their best-ever August, up 10.5% to 20.35 lakh units - total vehicle production across all categories crossed 31.57 lakh units for the month.

slides.eyebrow: Why it matters for Viksit Bharat 2047
slides.headline: This isn't a one-category story.
slides.body: Cars, two-wheelers and three-wheelers all posted record or near-record growth in the same month - a broad signal about what people are actually buying, not just one segment having a good quarter.
